title: PNP stresses impartiality after VP Duterte calls it ‘enforcement arm of politicians’
summary: The Philippine National Police has vowed impartiality and said its actions are “guided by the Constitution” after Vice President Sara Duterte said it “has become the enforcement arm of politicians,”…

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police has vowed impartiality and said its actions are “guided by the Constitution” after Vice President Sara Duterte said it “has become the enforcement arm of politicians,” following the police's dismissal of her former staff members’ kidnapping and coercion claims.
